notes.title: [Mythicard Update] Affinities Balancing
notes.notes:
I got a lot of feedback on some of the less used affinities, mentioning that they should be updated and this patch is a response to those request, I've updated a list of affinities in a way that I think make them more balanced in general and more in line with other affinities, here are the changes in no particular order:

Power Mixer: Increases +3 attack (up from +1)

Mix Limit: Allows you to play 2 cards per round (up from 1)

Raise: Added a new negative effect, making level 4 cost 11 gold

Unmixed: Adds 2 more cards to your hand (up from 1)

Privilege (Reworked): Start the game with 0 Coins and get 1 more coin every round

Coins Plan: Saved cards cost 1 more coin (Down from 2)

Hope everyone enjoys the changes!

notes.title: [Mythicard Update] Balancing patch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, here comes a balancing patch as well as some general fixes

Change log:


 Adonis is now a level 5 card
 Amphirite is now a level 5 card with 2 defense
 Sphinx now has 2 attack
 Pygmalion costs has been increased to 4
 icarus now costs 3 gold and applies magical shield to a friendly card
 Crius now costs 3 gold and can add +1 attack to a friendly Titan
 Artemis is now a God Kind card
 Tethys level has been increased to 4
 Medusa's attack has been increased to 3 and applies stun for 4 turns
 Orpheus level has been increased to 4
 Psyche new defense is 4 and cost is increased to 3
 Charon is now a level 5 card
 Fixed an issue where with certain combinations, the first class affinity didn't limit the number of blocked cards


I hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: [Mythicard Update] You can own affinity skills now!
notes.notes:
Here it is!

  Many of you have mentioned that the current way of expending the affinity points feels a bit unfair, so this patch is going to fix that.

  From now on, when you buy an affinity skill you will own it, meaning that you can disable or enable it whenever you want without having to spend more affinity points. 

  My hope is that this will enable a lot more experimentation and freedom when deciding what is the best combination for you!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38569189/a78e17ece17f5e1d1d41ae05a8951c6dad3293b7.png

Thanks everyone, and enjoy Mythicard!

notes.title: [Mythicard Update] Play and Practice with Bots
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone for a very fun release, I’ve been having a lot of fun playing with you! 

I’ve been getting feedback that some users want to be able to play without affecting their rank, in order to try new builds or just play with bots, this update introduces a game mode where you can do exactly that, play with bots without affecting your stats at all!.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38569189/17b323e359a766578b9b1c3aa1b4ed56ca1766b7.png

After the update you will see a new “Play Against Bots” button that will immediately start a game with bots, you can also enter as the leader of a party and it will immediately start a game with bots and your friends!

Have a great day, and let me know if you have any feedback!
